help.full:
Available commands:

Binding
/bind <pairing-token>

Sessions
/projects
/codex <project> [-a|-alias <alias>] [-yolo]
/claude <project> [-a|-alias <alias>] [-yolo]
/gemini <project> [-a|-alias <alias>] [-yolo]
/sessions
/switch <session>
/chat <session> <message>
/stop <session|all>

Channels
/channels [enable|disable <channel>]
/routes

Stats
/usage [today|yesterday|week|month]
/costs [today|yesterday|week|month]

Other
/status
/help
